parent_recipe.template_run: m1_muon_lr2.0_wd0.02_p0.5_s2030 (recipe fields read from its config.json/optimizer state, recorded field-by-field below)
parent_recipe.model: MiniMind 30,025,216 params, h512/L8/GQA-4/QK-norm/SwiGLU, tied embedding, BPE 6400, seq 256

schedule.rule: lr*mult_factor(t); probe LR at a restore point = value the NEXT update would consume under this clock (no warmup restart, no peak reuse)

parent_recipe.note: two restore points from ONE parent trajectory; not two seeds

probe_batches.rule: for state s, the 8 production batches immediately after step s (manifest slices [s:s+8)); first 4 = calibration, last 4 = check

targets.rule: sha256(('P0P1_Q_v1|'+group_id).encode()).digest()[0] % 3 -> 0=Q_select, 1=Q_P1_check, 2=Q_P2_endpoint; group = conversation_id translation thread; groups never straddle sets
targets.pool: OLD dev split only (thread-aligned mte_split_v2); confirm pools remain sealed
targets.exposure_note: old dev participated in M1/M2; results are development-level only

amplitude_probes.applies_to: Muon data update only; aux AdamW and WD untouched

cost.flops_formula: per NS step per matrix: 4*r^2*s + 2*r^3 (r=min(m,n)); group cost = sum over its 8 layers x K
cost.timing: >=20 alternating blocks, median reported; matched before any check-side objective is computed

joint_pool.definition: ordered pairs (g_minus: 5->3, g_plus: 5->7), others stay 5; feasibility = analytic FLOPs ratio and measured ratio both within [0.98,1.02] vs all-5 reference
joint_pool.proposals: top-2 by calibration mean of sum(B_g) within feasible pool; joint forward measured; target_primary locked; geometry_primary by calibration E_g^2 improvement (no Q); fixed_random_pair by pre-registered seed draw
controls_on_target_primary: gamma_const (median calibration gamma per changed group)
joint_pool.no_op_rule: if target_primary calibration joint mean not better than native, lock no-op and record

amo.outcome: arXiv 2605.17806v2 unreachable from this host; no local cache -> Q3 AMO/PE same-family comparison NOT executed, no numbers fabricated

screening.delta_step_rule: max(1e-5, 10*e_repeat) nats/valid-target; e_repeat = max diff of repeated native one-step point evaluation
screening.Q1_local_support: target_primary check mean > delta_step vs native, >=3/4 batches same sign, BOTH states, cost matched
screening.Q2: paired target vs group-gain/geometry differences; gamma_const parity => SCALAR_EXPLANATION_NOT_RULED_OUT
screening.negative_scope: fixed original-coefficient K=3/5/7 family and this setting only
